detached_structure.evidence: A gray-roofed building sits just southeast of the central house, but it may belong to the neighboring lot. A small structure or debris cluster also appears to the north of the house.

signals.notes: The central house has a gray, mildly weathered roof, a short driveway running south to the street with one parked vehicle, and a dry, patchy lawn. Large trees cast heavy shadows to the west and north.
